book.name: 1Tesalonika
book.title: Mukanda ua Paulu ua kulivanga kuli vaka TESALONIKA

content: Vuyoye vuje vuvuahelelesa Njambi

Mukumanusuila, vamuanetu, tumilomba nakumisindiya muli Muene Yesu, nguetu nge muje mumualilongesele kuli yetu vati munapande kuyoya linga muvuahelese Njambi. Nge muje mumuli nakulinga. Lingeni muje vene nakuvuezelelaho cikuma.
Omuo muatantekeya vishika vituamihanene kuhitila mu nzili yakama ya Muene Yesu.
Njambi atonda linga mupue vakulela nakupatuka ku vukoyi.
Muntu na muntu kuli yeni vamala atantekeye vati napande kuyoya na mpueyendi mu ngila yakulela nakasingimiko,
keti na vukoyi, ngue vakakuhona kutsiliela vaje kuvatantekeya Njambi.

Mucifua eci vene, naumo uahi ueni napande kulinga muamupi kuli vakuavo vaka Yesu cipue kuvazangamena. Tuaminanguile laja cuma eci, kaha tuaminanguile na nzili nguetu Muene akahana kashitiku kuli vaje vakalingi evi.
Njambi katusanene linga tuyoye mu vukoyi, vuno honi mu kulela.
Nankuma, uoshe uje aviana vilongesa evi kaviana muntu, vuno honi Njambi, uje akamihana Cimbembesi uendi Uakulela.
Kutuapandele kumisonekela via cizango kuli umo na mukuavo. Omuo yeni vavenia Njambi uamilongesele vati muje munapande kulizanga umo na mukuavo.
Kaha munakala nakulinga ngeci kuli vaka kutsiliela voshe mu Masendonia muoshe. Nankuma, tumilomba vakuetu, vuezeleleniko cikuma.
Pueni vaka kuyoya mukuholoka, hakeni mana eni ku viuma vieni, nakupanga viakulikuasa navio yeni vavenia, nge muje tuamilekele laja.
Mu ngila eyi vene, mukatambula kasingimiko kuli vaje keti vaka kutsiliela, kaha kumukayoyela muntu umo kuli vije munahonoua.
Kuija kua Muene
Vamuanetu, tutonda mutantekeye vusunga hali vaje vanatsi, linga keti mukale navusiua, nge vaje kuvesi nakutsiliela.
Omuo tunatsiliela nguetu Yesu uatsile, kaha uasangukile naua, kaha tunatsiliela nguetu Njambi akaneha hamo na Yesu vaje vatsile mukutsiliela kuli ikeye.
Evi tumilongesa hano vinapu vilongesa via Muene linga yetu vaje vacili nakuyoya ha litangua lije Munendi akeja kutukatuama kulutue lua vaje vanatsi.

Kukakala mutambi ua lizi liakama liakushika, lizi lia kangelo uakama, nakuohia kua tolombita ya Njambi, kaha Muene ikeye vavenia akashuluka kuhuma muilu. Kaha vaje vatsile mukutsiliela kuli Kilistu vakasangukila ku muono ha kulivanga,
ambahoni yetu vaje tucilinakuyoya ha ntsimbu ije vakatukunguluila hamo navo mu mashelua nakuliuana na Muene havukambuila. Kaha tukakala hamo na Muene ntsimbu yoshe.
Nankuma, litakameseni umo namukuavo na mezi aua.
